cards.exampleTranslation: Zhao Kuangyin established the Northern Song.
The Northern Song established its capital at Bianjing.
The ruler of the Song was the emperor.
The emperor controlled the army.

cards.example: 皇帝解除了将领的兵权。
cards.exampleTranslation: The emperor relieved the generals of their military power.
Military power was in the emperor's hands.
The Song had a powerful army.
The imperial examination system was very important.
The Jin Dynasty threatened the Northern Song.
The Northern Song fell.
The country split into two parts.

cards.example: 皇帝举行了盛大的酒宴。
cards.exampleTranslation: The emperor held a grand banquet.
One could become an official through the imperial examination.
The exam system selected talented people.

cards.example: 宋朝的价值观念重视教育。
cards.exampleTranslation: Song dynasty values emphasized education.
Wang Anshi carried out reforms.
Wang Anshi was the prime minister of Song.

cards.example: 变法改善了国家的财政。
cards.exampleTranslation: The reforms improved the state finances.
The government increased tax revenue.
Many ministers opposed the reforms.
Economic progress was very obvious.

cards.example: 城里有许多热闹的小巷。
cards.exampleTranslation: The city had many lively alleys.
The Song dynasty economy was thriving.

cards.back: fight; do battle; engage in war
cards.exampleTranslation: The army fought bravely.

cards.back: suffer a defeat; lose a battle
cards.exampleTranslation: The Song army suffered defeat and was forced to retreat.
The Jin troops attacked and seized Bianjing.
The Jin troops carried off the emperor.

cards.example: 无能的官员让国家陷入危机。
cards.exampleTranslation: Incompetent officials led the country into crisis.
The emperor governed the country.

cards.example: 皇帝和大臣们商量对策。
cards.exampleTranslation: The emperor discussed strategy with his ministers.
The Song dynasty began issuing paper currency.

cards.example: 世界上最早的钞票出现在宋朝。
cards.exampleTranslation: The world's earliest banknotes appeared in the Song dynasty.
The government issued new paper currency.

cards.example: 宋朝城市有各种娱乐活动。
cards.exampleTranslation: Song dynasty cities had all kinds of entertainment.

cards.example: 岳飞成为了抗金的元帅。
cards.exampleTranslation: Yue Fei became the marshal leading resistance against the Jin.
Yue Fei practiced martial arts from childhood.
Yue Fei was very hardworking.
Yue Fei achieved outstanding military merit.
Yue Fei vowed to recover the lost territories.
The people all respected Yue Fei.

cards.back: sue for peace; seek a truce
cards.exampleTranslation: The emperor wanted to sue for peace with the Jin.
Qin Hui ordered Yue Fei to withdraw his troops.
The emperor recalled Yue Fei.
Qin Hui falsely accused Yue Fei of treason.

cards.example: 岳飞品德高尚，受人爱戴。
cards.exampleTranslation: Yue Fei had noble character and was loved by all.

cards.example: 宋朝人喜欢看杂技表演。
cards.exampleTranslation: Song dynasty people loved watching acrobatic shows.
